stage: P2-R mechanism diagnosis (diagnostic only; not a method-selection stage)
role: D-dev-select (already exposed; exploratory causal diagnosis only)

population.secondary_stratification: EN-confusion span_initial (previous reference unit MATCH or none) vs within-span; descriptive

target_tokens.EN: reference-consistent first-token set after the exact generated prefix: variants {raw, lower, Capitalized, UPPER} x {'', ' '}; prefix IDs must be unchanged; distinguishing beginning (stripped lower-cased token text is a prefix of the word, length >= min(2, len(word))); log p(ref) = log of summed probability over the set; rank = best rank in the set
target_tokens.EN-correct: the same set; the baseline token must belong to it
target_tokens.probabilities: suppression-processed next-token distribution (the decode rule); raw-logit quantities co-reported

energy.target_edit_norm_source: sqrt(1203.3762345332195 / 949): RMS realized edit norm of the selected P2 run (results/inference_cf/p2_final_summary.json)
energy.solver: inside the hook action on the pre-edit site state r: analytic NormPreserve chord solution s = |r| sin(theta*) / sin(phi - theta*), theta* = 2 asin(e*/(2|r|)), phi = angle(r, v); then bf16 secant refinement of s by re-evaluating models.hooks.apply_steering on r (the exact hook arithmetic); max 8 evaluations; never reads logits or correctness
energy.direction_passed_to_hook: s * v as a (D,) tensor with gain 1 and alpha 1 (avoids bf16 rounding of the scalar gain)
energy.unreachable: phi <= theta*: condition recorded as energy_unreachable, no edit, position excluded from matched comparisons involving it

directions.plus_d: d = norm(hE - hB) at the position (core_p1.direction, fallback -> excluded)

random.construction: project orthogonal to the pre-edit site state r (float64), normalize
random.degeneracy_fallback: if the projected norm < 1e-8: e_0 projected orthogonal to r, normalized
random.count: exactly one vector per position; no seed selection or retries

d1.pulse: each arm edits only the query predicting token t, from the same unedited B-branch cache (cropped back after every arm); no earlier intervention
d1.companion: first 20 selected positions per stratum: after the pulse, greedy free continuation with no further edits to the 200-token cap (all four arms)

d2.current: controlled baseline-prefix replay of the frozen P2 schedule (L16, alpha 2, g = E*R_B via the frozen R2 providers, phi_id, +d, NormPreserve, persistent S-branch cache) while feeding the matched-baseline tokens
d2.oracle: energy-packet relocation: keep current edits at D2 targets; order the other positive-energy edits (donors) by descending realized energy (ties: position); assign each once to an unedited target in frozen hash order within the same utterance; remove the donor edit; destination direction d_t = norm(hE_t - hB_t), +d; destination energy = the donor's realized edit norm via the D1 solver; unmatched donors and all other edits unchanged
d2.targets: all valid EN-confusion positions (target rule above) in the D1 utterances
d2.controls: all valid EN-correct and ZH-correct positions in the D1 utterances (damage)
d2.pulse_companion: first 20 relocations in plan order: single pulse at the donor's original position vs at the oracle target, from the clean baseline prefix, free continuation, no further edits
d2.acoustic_annotation: at D2 targets with a valid CTC midpoint: evaluator-centred 1.0 s window clipped to [0, heard audio]; unchanged LocalSupport provider; report timing error |current window centre - midpoint| and E(oracle crop) - E(current)
d2.schedule_source: frozen P2 selected configuration L16_a2_ER_id_pos (alpha 2, g = E*R_B, phi_id, +d)

bootstrap.aggregation: average positions within dialogue, then average dialogues
bootstrap.simultaneous: Bonferroni over the frozen primary family (two-sided 95% family-wise)
